generals.title: Incwadi Yamajenene
generals.author: Ines Varga
pages: Cabanga ngeqembu lamajenene akanise azungeze idolobha. Angakhuluma kuphela ngezithunywa, futhi kumele wonke ahlasele ndawonye noma wonke alinde. Ukuhlasela ngengxenye kuwumphumela omubi kunayo yonke.

Manje ake sithi amanye amajenene angamambuka. Imbuka ingatshela umakhelwane oyedwa ithi “hlaselani” bese itshela omunye ithi “hlehlani”. Izithunywa zingephuza. Akekho ongabona okungaphakathi ethendeni lomunye.

Ososayensi bekhompyutha lokhu bakubiza ngokuthi inkinga yamajenene ase-Byzantine. Uhlelo oluqhubeka luvumelana noma amanye amalungu eqamba amanga, ethula, noma etshela abangane abahlukene izinto ezihlukene, kuthiwa luyakwazi ukubekezelela amaphutha e-Byzantine.
Isimbumbano sabagadi siwuhlelo olunjalo. Abagadi abathembekile abadingi ukwazi ukuthi obani abangamambuka. Badinga amazwi athembekile anele, nomthetho oguqula lawo mazwi abe yisinqumo esisodwa.

third.title: Oyedwa Kwabathathu
third.author: Tomas Oyelaran
pages: Iqembu lingabekezelela abaqambimanga abangaki? Ukuze isivumelwano singahlukani neze, bangaphansi kwengxenye eyodwa kwezintathu. Isimbumbano sabagadi abangu-n singabekezelela abagadi abangu-f abanephutha kuphela uma u-n emkhulu kuno-3f.

Kungani ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu? Noma yimaphi amaqembu amabili amakhulu ngokwanele ukwenza isinqumo kumele abe nelungu elithembekile okungenani elilodwa abahlanganyela ngalo. Uma abangaphezu kwengxenye eyodwa kwezintathu bengaqamba amanga, izinqumo ezimbili eziphikisanayo zingabonakala zombili zisemthethweni, bese isimbumbano sihlukana.

Ngakho abagadi abane basinda komubi oyedwa, abayisikhombisa basinda kwababili, abayishumi basinda kwabathathu. Umgadi wesihlanu noma wesithupha akengezi ukuphepha; owesikhombisa kuphela owenza iphutha lesibili liphephe.
Khumbula lezi zibalo uma umkhandlu uvota. Wonke umgadi othembekile okhishwa ngephutha usondeza ama-Byzantine kuleyo ngxenye eyodwa kwezintathu, futhi uma beyifinyelela, isimbumbano siyema.

blind.title: Uyinki Ongaboni
blind.author: Mara Quell
pages: I-Mint isayina inothi ukuze wonke umuntu azi ukuthi lingokwangempela. Kodwa uma i-Mint ibona wonke amanothi ewasayinayo, ingalandelela ngalinye kusukela kumuntu olicelile kuya kumuntu olisebenzisayo.
Isiginesha engaboni iyayixazulula le nkinga. Ufaka inothi lakho emvilophini elifihlayo ngaphambi kokulinikela, bese i-Mint isayina phezu kwemvilophu ingakuboni okungaphakathi.

Uma usubuyele ekhaya, ukhipha imvilophu. Isiginesha isahlala inembile enothini elingaphansi, kodwa i-Mint ayikaze ilibone. Uma inothi libuya ukuze lisetshenziswe, i-Mint ingayihlola isiginesha kodwa ayikwazi ukusho ukuthi belingelikabani.

UDavid Chaum wachaza lo mqondo ngo-1982, futhi uyinhliziyo ye-ecash. Esimbumbanweni, abagadi baqhuba i-Mint ndawonye, ngakho akekho umgadi oyedwa ongasayina amanothi yedwa noma aphrinte amanye ngasese.

twice.title: Lisetshenziswe Kabili
twice.author: Kofi Adeyemi
pages: Inothi lephepha alikwazi ukuba sephaketheni ezimbili ngesikhathi esisodwa. Inothi ledijithali liyinombolo nje, futhi izinombolo zingakopishwa. Pho yini evimbela umuntu ukuthi asebenzise inothi elifanayo kabili?
I-Mint igcina uhlu lwawo wonke amanothi asesetshenzisiwe. Uma kufika inothi, abagadi bahlola uhlu. Uma inothi likulo, liyenqatshwa; uma lingekho, liyamukelwa bese lengezwa.

Abagadi kumele bavumelane ngalolo hlu. Uma omunye umgadi engamukela inothi omunye alenqabile, uhlamvu lwemali olufanayo lungasetshenziswa ezindaweni ezimbili. Yingakho konke ukusetshenziswa kwemali kudlula ekuvumelaneni.
E-Ledger Archive uzingela kanye lokhu: inothi elivela kabili, noma isiginesha engafani. Ukubamba elilodwa kugcina sonke isimbumbano sithembekile.

powers.title: Amanothi Amandla Kabili
powers.author: Lucia Brandt
pages: Amanothi e-ecash eza ngobukhulu obunqunyiwe: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 njalo njalo, ngalinye liphindwe kabili kunelandulelayo. Noma yimuphi umthamo ungakhiwa ngawo, njengoba noma iyiphi inombolo ingabhalwa ngebhinari.
Ubukhulu obunqunyiwe busiza ubumfihlo. Uma amanothi awo wonke umuntu eza ngamanani ambalwa afanayo, inothi lama-sats angu-64 alisho lutho ngokuthi ngubani onalo noma belingelani.
Uma ukhokha, unikela ngamanothi afinyelela intengo. I-Mint iyawathatha bese ikhipha amanothi amasha oshintshi wakho, ngakho akukho okusebenzisile okungaxhunyaniswa nalokho okubuyiselwayo.

Yingakho izitolo zase-Beach Town nase-Port Concord zikucela ukuthi ukhethe amanothi ku-wallet yakho. Inothi ongalidingi liyenqatshwa: i-Mint iyakunika ushintshi, kodwa ngeke ithathe ngaphezu kwalokho okufanele ukukhokhe.

keepers.title: Abagcini base-Port Concord
keepers.author: Abena Mensah
pages: I-Mint yesimbumbano iqhutshwa yiqembu labagadi esikhundleni senkampani eyodwa. Umgadi ngamunye uphethe ingxenye yokhiye wokusayina, futhi ayikho ingxenye engasayina lutho iyodwa.
Ukuze kusayinwe, kumele kuvume abagadi abafinyelela umkhawulo. Uma kunabagadi abane, umkhawulo ngabathathu; uma bayisikhombisa, ngabahlanu. Ngaphansi komkhawulo, akukho okunyakazayo.

Abagadi bavame ukuba ngabantu asebethembana kakade: abanikazi bezitolo bedolobha, abadala bomphakathi, abangane abagcina amaseva esebenza. Isimbumbano sisabalalisa ukwethemba esikhundleni sokukunqwabelanisa endaweni eyodwa.

Ukuba ngumgadi kuyisibopho, hhayi umqhele. Ugcina iseva yakho isebenza, uhlola sonke isiphakamiso, futhi wenqaba ukusayina lokho ongakwazi ukukuqinisekisa. Yilowo wonke umsebenzi, futhi yiwo wonke umdlalo.

harbourTales.title: Izindaba Zetheku: Izindaba Zabantu base-Port Concord
harbourTales.author: Wren Osei
pages: Umboleki Wezambulela. Njalo ngoLwesibili olunemvula, uNkk Dorothea Pike wasehholo lezinhlanzi e-Saltmarket ubeka ibhakede lezambulela eceleni kwesitebele sakhe ngaphansi kophawu oluthi: BOLEKA ESISODWA, LETHA ESISODWA. Eminyakeni engamashumi amathathu akakaze athenge isambulela. Ibhakede ligcwala ngokwalo, ngezimnyama, ezinemigqa nesisodwa esimise okwedada. Entwasahlobo edlule itilosi labuyisa isambulela elasiboleka liseyingane. “Uxolo ngokwephuza,” lasho. “Bengizungeza i-Cape kabili.” Walinika i-herring ngokwethembeka kwalo.

Umbhaki wase-Low Tide. Imigwaqo yase-Low Tide inodlame, kodwa njalo ngo-4 ekuseni inuka i-cardamom. Yibhikawozi likaRavi Menon, elingenalo uphawu ngoba alidingi. Njalo ebusuku uRavi ushiya esitebhisini ithileyi lamabhanisi asele kunoma ubani owadingayo. Ngelinye ilanga othile wathatha ithileyi lonke. Ngobusuku obulandelayo labuya, lihlanziwe, nencwadi yokubonga nesinkwa sakhe uqobo, esishile kancane. URavi waphina leyo ncwadi ngaphezu kwehhavini, lapho isalenga khona, iba nsundu kancane kancane.

Ishifu Yasebusuku e-Signet Row. Unesi u-Imogen Tal usebenze ebusuku esibhedlela iminyaka eyishumi nanye, futhi iminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye yayo ijuba belilokhu lingqongqoza efasiteleni lakhe ngo-3 impela. Ulibiza ngokuthi uMbhalisi, ngoba lihlola konke lingavumi lutho. Ngobunye ubusika uMbhalisi wayeka ukuza, u-Imogen wamangala ukuthi kumkhathaza kangakanani. NgoMashi labuya nomlingani nehlahla, lakha isidleke emaphethelweni efasitela, eduze kophawu oluthi AKUVUNYELWE IZIDLEKE.

Umbali Wezinyoni Zasolwandle. Ematsheni ase-Gullmoor kuhlala uBarnaby Quist nencwajana nesiqu sepensela, ebala izinyoni zasolwandle. Uzibale njalo ekuseni selokhu athatha umhlalaphansi ezikebheni zokuwela, nakuba kungekho owake wamcela. “Kufanele kube khona owaziyo,” usho kanjalo. Inani livame ukuba cishe amakhulu amane. Kwesinye isikhathi laba amakhulu amane nanye, uBarnaby wachitha isonto lonke ethola ukuthi kungani. Kwakuyi-tern: ilahlekile, inamahloni, futhi ngokubona kwakhe, yamukeleke kakhulu.

gullSongs.title: Izingoma Zezinyoni Zasolwandle Namanye Amavesi Etheku
gullSongs.author: Hettie Gorse, Imbongi yase-Gullmoor
pages: Inyoni Esigxotsheni. Inyoni esigxotsheni, inyoni ensikeni, / inyoni ekugcineni phezu komthunzi womthengisi wezinhlanzi; / inyoni ene-chip necebo elibi kabi, / inyoni entshontshe konke ukudla kwasemini kwendoda. / Inyoni e-Mint Hall, ihlola ulayini, / ibuka amanothi njengoba umgadi ebengenza; / icikiza amehlo, isola, ithambekisa ikhanda: / “Ingabe leli ngelangempela? Noma yisinkwa nje?”

Amanzi Aphansi. Amanzi ayaphuma njengesivakashi esitshelwe / ukuthi idili seliphelile, isobho seliyabanda. / Ashiya odakeni izinkezo zawo nokhiye bawo, / ibhuzu nebhodlela, inkalankala nophizi abambalwa. / Bese ebuya, enamahloni, ngo-10:20, / embesa ichweba sengathi akwenzekanga lutho, / nezikebhe ebezilele zitsheke esihlabathini / ziyavuka zibheke nxazonke sengathi konke bekuhleliwe.

Ubusuku Bamalambu. Ngobusuku bamalambu ichweba ligqoka / izibani ezincane eziyinkulungwane; / zintanta njengemithandazo ehlebezwayo / nezinhlanzi zibheke phezulu zethukile. / Izikebhe ziyanqekuza, izinyoni ziyathula, / isikebhe sokuwela sifiphaza umsebe waso, / futhi lonke ifasitela egqumeni / liyancika ukuze libuke umfudlana. / Bese kude ngale komphetho we-Shallows / ilambu lokugcina elincane liyantanta, / liyotshela inyanga ukuthi idolobha lithembisile / ukugcina izithembiso nezindaba zalo.

Isihlabelelo Somgwedli. Thula manje, amagagasi ayaphenduka, / amabhoya akhala kancane; / isibani se-Concord siyavutha / ukuze siqondise izikebhe ngezansi. / Amanetha omile agoqiwe, / izinyoni sezilele, / inyanga, uhlamvu lwesiliva, / igingqika phezulu. / Ngakho vala amehlo, tilosi lami, / ichweba liyalinda, / nokusa, njengomthungi, / kuzothunga isibhakabhaka ngegolide.

saltKitchen.title: Ikhishi Likasawoti: Izindlela Zokupheka Zasetheku
saltKitchen.author: U-Auntie Priya Fernandes wase-Saltmarket
pages: Ama-fishcake ase-Saltmarket (angu-8). Bilisa u-500 g wamazambane anofulawa aze athambe, uwakhiphe emanzini, uwagxobe. Pheka u-400 g wenhlanzi emhlophe noma i-haddock ebhenyiwe obisini imizuzu engu-6, uyihlephule, uqaphele amathambo. Xuba konke nedlanzana le-parsley eqotshiwe, isipuni se-capers, ikhasi likalamula eligayiwe, usawoti nopelepele. Bumba amaqebelengwane angu-8, uwabandise imizuzu engu-30. Gcoba ngalinye ngofulawa, iqanda eliphehliwe nemvuthuluka yesinkwa. Thosa emafutheni amancane, imizuzu engu-3 kuya ku-4 uhlangothi ngalunye, aze abe nsundu. Phakela nolamula nophizi.

I-chowder yase-Low Tide (eyabantu abangu-4). Thosa izingcezu ezingu-4 ze-bacon eqotshiwe ebhodweni elikhulu zize ziqine. Engeza u-anyanisi oqotshiwe nezigaxa ezimbili ze-celery, uthambise imizuzu engu-5. Govuza isipuni sikafulawa, bese ufaka u-500 ml we-stock yenhlanzi noma yemifino namazambane ama-2 asikiwe. Bilisa kancane imizuzu engu-12, aze athambe amazambane. Engeza u-400 g wenhlanzi emhlophe ngezigaxa nedlanzana lommbila omnandi, ubilise kancane eminye imizuzu engu-5. Thela u-250 ml wobisi noma ukhilimu, ukufudumeze ungakubilisi, bese ufaka upelepele ne-thyme.

I-Masala Chai ye-Mint Hall (eyabantu ababili). Epanini elincane, bilisa u-250 ml wamanzi namakhoba ama-4 e-cardamom eluhlaza achotshoziwe, ijinja egayiwe elingana nesithupha, ama-clove ama-2 nocezu oluncane lwesinamoni. Bilisa kancane imizuzu engu-3. Engeza amathisipuni ama-2 etiye elimnyama elixegayo, njenge-Assam, ubilise kancane omunye umzuzu owodwa. Thela u-250 ml wobisi uwubuyisele ekubileni okuthambile, ubhekisise: i-chai ikhuphuka ngokushesha futhi iyathanda ukweqa. Faka ushukela ngokuthanda kwakho, uhluze ezinkomishini, uphuze niphikisana ngamathebula amagagasi.

I-Dal ye-Tidewater Temple (eyabantu abangu-4). Geza u-200 g wamalentili abomvu kuze kube amanzi acwebile. Wabilise kancane ku-800 ml wamanzi nengxenye yethisipuni ye-turmeric imizuzu engu-20, ugovuza ngezikhathi ezithile, aze athambe abe nokhilimu, bese ufaka usawoti. Epanini elincane, shisisa izipuni ezinkulu ezi-2 ze-ghee noma amafutha, ufake ithisipuni yembewu ye-cumin uyiyeke ihahaze. Engeza u-anyanisi oqotshiwe, ama-clove ama-2 kagalikhi, ijinja encane ne-chilli eluhlaza, uthose kuze kube nsundu ngokwegolide. Thela le tarka ku-dal, ukhame ulamula, uhlakaze i-coriander, uphakele nelayisi.

Izwi Elivela Ekhishini. Inhlanzi entsha inuka ulwandle, hhayi phansi ehholo lezinhlanzi; uma ungabaza, buza umthengisi wezinhlanzi, futhi uma umthengisi ebheka eceleni, thenga amalentili. Geza izandla ngemva kokuphatha inhlanzi eluhlaza, uyipheke ize ingasabonakali ngale futhi ihlephuke kalula, futhi ugcine izandla ezincane kude namafutha ashisayo. Zonke izindlela zokupheka kule ncwadi zazanywa kubagadi be-Mint, abakhethayo, nakuzinyoni zasolwandle zase-Gullmoor, ezingakhethi.

lighthouseKid.title: UPip Nesibani se-Concord
lighthouseKid.author: Marigold Tenpenny
pages: Ekugcineni kwe-Gullmoor, ngale kwebhentshi lokugcina nomgqomo wokugcina, kumi indlu yesibani yase-Concord Point, futhi endlwaneni engezansi kwayo kwakuhlala intombazane okuthiwa uPip. Ugogo kaPip wayegcina isibani. Njalo kusihlwa wayekhuphuka izitebhisi eziyikhulu neshumi nambili, asonge iwashi elikhulu elijikisa ilambu, apholishe ingilazi ize ikhazimule njengebhamuza lensipho. UPip wayebala izitebhisi ngezwi eliphezulu. Akakaze aphazame nakanye, nakuba ngezinye izikhathi ayebala nekati.

Ngobunye ubusuku besiphepho, uGogo wathimula kakhulu waze wahlala phansi ezitebhisini akakwazi ukuphinde asukume. “Amadolo ami,” esho, “asesule emsebenzini.” Ilambu lalingakalunyekwa. Phandle emvuleni, isikebhe sokuwela sasebusuku sasibuyela ekhaya, namatshe aseduze kwe-Gullmoor ayesilindile, emnyama futhi enesineke. UPip wabheka phezulu ezitebhisini eziyikhulu neshumi nambili. Wabe esebheka ikati. Ikati labheka eceleni. “Kulungile,” kusho uPip. “Ngizohamba mina.”

UPip wakhuphuka. Esitebhisini samashumi amane umoya wahhewula. Esitebhisini samashumi ayisishiyagalombili umbhoshongo wanyakaza, kancane nje, njengoba imibhoshongo yenza. Esitebhisini seyikhulu neshumi nambili wathola ukhiye omkhulu wethusi, wasonga iwashi njengoGogo, amajika ayishumi hhayi elilodwa ngaphezulu, walumeka ilambu. Lavuka ngokuthi whoomph. Umsebe walo wajikeleza phezu kwamanzi, uzungeza, usho lokho izindlu zesibani ezihlala zikusho: nanka amatshe, nanti ichweba, buyela ekhaya ngale ndlela.

Kude, ukaputeni wesikebhe wabona isibani, wajikisa isondo, wangena ngokuphepha e-Port Concord bonke abagibeli bomile futhi bekhonona. Ekuseni ukaputeni wakhuphuka igquma nethini lamabhisikidi nomcamelo wamadolo kaGogo. Futhi uPip? UPip wathola ibheji lethusi elithi Umsizi Womgcini, alifaka nsuku zonke, ngisho nasebhavini. Ikati lathola ibhisikidi, elalingalifanele, kodwa elalidla ngesithunzi esikhulu.

nightFerry.title: Indaba Yesikebhe Sasebusuku
nightFerry.author: Constance Fairweather
pages: Isahluko Sokuqala. Isikebhe sango-11:40 esisuka e-Reef Docks sasiyisikebhe sokugcina esiya e-Shallows, futhi uNkosazana Odessa Crane, owayengumphathi womtapo wolwazi wetheku, wayesigibela njalo ngoLwesine ngenxa yokuthula. Kulobu busuku kwakungathulile. Egumbini lokuhlala kwakukhona umdlali we-accordion ongayeki, umthengisi wezinhlanzi nebhokisi lokubandisa, umgadi osemusha ebambelele ebhokisini lesikhumba, nomphathi wesikebhe, uMnu Hobb, owayephethe i-Regatta Cup esikhwameni se-velvet eya kukomiti eziqhingini. “Akekho oyithintayo,” kusho yena. Bonke babefuna ukuyithinta.

Isahluko Sesibili. Phakathi nendawo, izibani zacwayiza zacima. Imizuzwana eyishumi nanye kwazwakala kuphela ukukhala kwamapulangwe esikebhe nenothi elilodwa elide lokwethuka elivela ku-accordion. Lapho izibani zibuya, isikhwama se-velvet sasilele siyisicaba etafuleni. I-Cup yayingasekho. UMnu Hobb wakhipha umsindo onjengeketela. Ukaputeni wakhiya iminyango. “Akekho ophumayo,” esho, “size sibophele e-Shallows.” UNkosazana Crane wabeka phansi i-cocoa yakhe. Wezwa sengathi kuzoba ngolunye lwalezo Lwesine.

Isahluko Sesithathu. UNkosazana Crane wabhala uhlu, ngoba abaphathi bemitapo yolwazi bahlala benza njalo. Ibhokisi lomthengisi wezinhlanzi lalibanda kakhulu futhi lisinda kakhulu. Umdlali we-accordion wayenemikhono emanzi, nakuba lalinganini. Umgadi osemusha wenqaba ukuvula ibhokisi lesikhumba, ethi kuphela liqukethe “umsebenzi wesimbumbano”. Futhi umphathi wayeyipholishile i-Cup ngalo lelo kusasa, ngakho izigxivizo zeminwe yakhe azifakazeli lutho. Eduze kwefasitelana wathola i-sequin eyodwa yegolide nebala lento enuka okokupholisha ithusi ne-peppermint.

Isahluko Sesine. “Mnu Hobb,” kusho uNkosazana Crane, “ngubani obazi ukuthi i-Cup izoba kulesi sikebhe kulobu busuku?” “Yikomiti kuphela,” kusho umphathi, “nanoma ubani ofunda ibhodi lezaziso e-Reef Docks.” Ngakho, wonke umuntu. UNkosazana Crane wabubula wabheka ngefasitelana. Ngaphansi kwalo, kuntanta entanjeni emkhondweni omnyama wesikebhe, kwakukhona ibhoya elincane elisawolintshi elalingekho lapho behamba. Wamamatheka okokuqala kusihlwa sonke. “Kaputeni,” esho, “singehlisa ijubane kancane nje?” (Kuzoqhubeka.)

charter.title: Umqulu wase-Port Concord
charter.author: UMkhandlu Wokuqala wase-Port Concord
pages: Isingeniso. Thina, bantu base-Port Concord, abadobi nababhaki, omabhalane nabagcini, abagadi nezinyoni zasolwandle (izinyoni azisayinanga, kodwa zazikhona), sibeka le mithetho ukuze ichweba libe nobulungiswa, imigwaqo iphephe nesobho lishise. Lapho lo Mqulu ungacacile khona, izakhamuzi zizokhetha incazelo enomusa kakhulu. Lapho uthule khona, zizobuza umakhelwane. Lapho uziphikisa khona, zizoletha amabhisikidi e-Council Hill ziyixazulule.

Isigaba I: UMkhandlu. Idolobha liphethwe ngumkhandlu wabayisishiyagalolunye, abakhethwa yizakhamuzi njalo eminyakeni emithathu. Asikho isinqumo esibopha idolobha ngaphandle uma iningi elicacile livuma, futhi alikho ikhansela elingavota odabeni olulikhokhelayo. Imihlangano ivulekele bonke. Noma yisiphi isakhamuzi singakhuluma imizuzu emithathu, kubalwa ngewashi lamaqanda eligcinelwe lokho, elingeke liphazanyiswe, linyakaziswe noma lifihlwe esigqokweni.

Isigaba II: Ichweba. Ichweba ngelabo bonke, futhi akekho ongalivimba. Sonke isikebhe sinikeza indlela esikebheni esisenkingeni. Isibani sase-Concord Point sizolunyekwa njalo ebusuku ngaphandle kokwehluleka, ngisho namaholide, ngisho noma kunokufutheka. Izinhlanzi ezithengiswa e-Saltmarket kumele zikalwe ngokwethembeka, futhi noma yisiphi isikali esitholakala sikhohlisa sizoboniswa e-City Hall nelebula elichaza ukuthi senzeni.

Isigaba III: I-Mint. Amanothi edolobha asayinwa yisimbumbano sabagadi, hhayi isandla esisodwa kuphela. Akekho umgadi ongasayina lokho angakuhlolanga, futhi noma yisiphi isakhamuzi singabuza ukuthi i-Mint izigcina kanjani izincwadi zayo. Abagadi basebenzela idolobha; idolobha alisebenzeli abagadi. Umgadi owephula ukwethembeka uzovotelwa ukuphuma ngabanye abagadi, nengubo yakhe inikezwe umuntu onenhlonipho engcono.

Isigaba IV: Omakhelwane. Sonke isakhamuzi singakhonza ngendlela esiyikhethayo: e-Harbour Chapel, kuma-mandir, e-Tidewater Temple noma etsheni elithulile e-Shallows. Wonke umuzi unganeka izingubo ngoMsombuluko. Umsindo ngemva kwamabili uvunyelwe emishadweni, emikhosini nasezimweni eziphuthumayo zangempela kuphela, futhi inyoni yasolwandle akusona isimo esiphuthumayo sangempela. Izinguquko kulo Mqulu zidinga izingxenye ezimbili kwezintathu zomkhandlu nenkomishi yetiye eyodwa ikhansela ngalinye.

harbourHistory.title: Kusuka Exhibeni Kuya Ethekwini Elikhululekile: Umlando wase-Port Concord
harbourHistory.author: UDkt Ambrose Kettlewell, Umgcini Womlando Wedolobha
pages: Ekuqaleni kwakukhona umgoqo wesihlabathi, umthombo wamanzi ahlanzekile nomndeni wabadobi abaneqholo kakhulu abenqaba ukushiya kokubili. Bakha amaxhiba amathathu ogwini lapho manje kuyi-Gullmoor, babhenya izinhlanzi zabo emililweni yezinkuni ezilethwe ulwandle. Izikebhe ezidlulayo zeza ngenxa yamanzi zahlala ngenxa ye-mackerel ebhenyiwe. Esizukulwaneni esisodwa amaxhiba amathathu aba ngamashumi amathathu, futhi othile wakha ijethi, ikakhulukazi ngezintango zabanye abantu.

Idolobha elakhula ogwini lalibizwa, ngaphandle kokucabanga okukhulu, ngokuthi i-Beach Town. Lalijabulisa, linodaka futhi linomsindo, futhi zonke izinhlobo zokuhweba zafika lapho: usawoti, izintambo, izinongo namahlebezi. Lapho imakethe isikhulele isihlabathi, abahwebi bathuthela ngaphakathi emigwaqweni efanele bafulela ihholo lezinhlanzi ngama-slate. Abahwebi bosawoti babenezitebele ezinkulu namazwi aphezulu kakhulu, futhi ngesikhathi amabalazwe edwetshwa kabusha, i-Beach Town yayisiyi-Saltmarket.

Njengoba ukuhweba kukhula, kwakhula nokukhathazeka. Abaphangi basolwandle babembalwa, kodwa abaqoqi bentela abavela enyakatho yogu babebaningi. Ngakho abantu bakha indlu yesango egqumeni ngaphezu kwechweba, enomgwaqo owodwa ongenayo nomnyango omkhulu we-oki. Ogcina isango wayegcina ukuthula. Eminyakeni eyalandela indlu yesango yakhula yaba negumbi lomkhandlu, amahhovisi, iwashi, futhi igquma laba yi-Council Hill. I-Gate Tower endala isemi, futhi umnyango wayo usabambeka uma kunemvula.

Ushintsho olukhulu lokugcina lweza ne-Mint. Abahwebi base bekhathele ukuthemba umboleki-mali oyedwa owayegcina incwadi yakhe yama-akhawunti ngaphansi kwesigqoko sakhe. Ngakho idolobha lakhetha isimbumbano sabagadi ukuze sisayine amanothi alo ndawonye, ukuze kungabikho mgcini oyedwa ongakhohlisa futhi kungabikho ukwehluleka okukodwa okungamisa imali yedolobha. I-Mint Hall yakhiwa endaweni yakudala yokwenza izintambo. I-Port Concord iphikisane ngacishe yonke into kusukela lapho, kodwa hhayi ngalokho.

councilMinutes.title: Amaminithi oMkhandlu, Umhlangano No. 1,412
councilMinutes.author: UPrudence Ogilvy, uMabhalane woMkhandlu
pages: Ababekhona: uMeya, amakhansela ayisishiyagalombili, umabhalane, amalungu amabili omphakathi nenyoni yasolwandle, eyangena ngefasitela ngo-7:04 futhi engaphinde ibhalwe. Abaxolisile: iKhansela uFenwick (udokotela wamazinyo). Umhlangano wavulwa ngo-7:00 ngempikiswano yokuthi wawuvulwe yini ngo-7:00, ngoba iwashi le-Chamber lishesha ngemizuzu emine. Kwavunyelwana ukuthi iwashi liyashesha, nokuthi akekho ozolilungisa, ngoba lenza imihlangano iqale ngesikhathi.

Isihloko 1: Ibhentshi e-Harbour Parade. IKhansela uBrightwater labika ukuthi ibhentshi elingaphandle kwehholo lezinhlanzi liyazamazama. IKhansela uDunmore lathi selizamazame iminyaka engamashumi amabili futhi umphakathi uyalithanda. Ilungu lomphakathi lathi lona alilithandi futhi lachitha i-chowder. Ngemva kwemizuzu engamashumi amane yengxoxo kwanqunywa ukuthi kufakwe i-beer mat egoqiwe ngaphansi komlenze omfushane, nokuthi udaba lubuyekezwe entwasahlobo.

Isihloko 2: I-Regatta. I-regatta izoqhubeka ngoMgqibelo wesibili wehlobo. UMkhandlu waphawula ngokudabuka ukuthi isikebhe esanqoba ngonyaka odlule kamuva satholakala siyibhavu elinoseyili. Imithetho ichitshiyelwe ukuze ithi okungenela kumele kube yizikebhe. IKhansela uPike labuza ukuthi ibhavu elintantayo ngokomthetho liyisikebhe yini. UMeya wathi sekwephuzile. Umbuzo wadluliselwa kukomidi elincane, okuyiKhansela uPike.

Isihloko 3: Okunye. I-Mint yabika ukuthi bonke abagadi bakhona, onke amanothi ayalingana, nokuthi ithini elilodwa lamabhisikidi lilahlekile egumbini lokusayina. Ithini kamuva latholakala ngaphansi kwesihlalo sikaMeya. UMeya waxolisa. IKhansela uFenwick lafika livela kudokotela wamazinyo lavotela ukuphikisa konke ngomkhuba, kwathi uma sekuchaziwe lakuvumela konke. Umhlangano wavalwa ngo-9:41. Umhlangano olandelayo: uLwesine, isikhathi esifanayo, iwashi elifanayo.

tideTables.title: I-Almanac ye-Concord Yamagagasi Nezimpawu
tideTables.author: UKaputeni Halvard Nkemelu, owayengumphathi wetheku
pages: Ngamagagasi. Ulwandle luyakhuphuka lwehle cishe kabili ngosuku, ludonswa ikakhulukazi yiNyanga futhi kancane yiLanga. Amanzi aphakeme afika cishe ngemizuzu engamashumi amahlanu kamuva usuku ngalunye, ngoba iNyanga nayo iphuma kamuva. Lapho iLanga neNyanga beqondana, ngenyanga entsha negcwele, amagagasi aba makhulu kakhulu: lawa ngama-spring tide, angahlangene nesizini. Ngengxenye yenyanga umehluko mncane kakhulu: ama-neap tide. Hlola ithebula njalo ngaphambi kokubopha isikebhe e-Shallows, funa sichithe intambama phezu kwesihlabathi sibukeka siyisiphukuphuku.

Ngama-knot, Ijubane. I-knot iyimayela elilodwa lasolwandle ngehora, futhi imayela lasolwandle lingamamitha angu-1,852, cishe iminithi elilodwa le-latitude. Amatilosi akudala ayekala ijubane ngokuphonsa ugodo oluboshwe entanjeni enamafindo ngamabanga alinganayo, abale amafindo aphumayo ngesikhathi esinqunyiwe. Ngamafindo, Intambo. Funda amathathu futhi abase-Reef Docks ngeke bakuhleke: i-bowline yenza indilinga engashibiliki, i-clove hitch ibophela esigxotsheni ngokushesha, ne-reef knot ibopha imikhawulo emibili yentambo eyodwa, njengalapho kugoqwa useyili.

Ngamafulegi Ezimpawu. Uhlamvu ngalunye lwe-alfabhethi lunefulegi, futhi amaningi asho okuthile ngokwawo. Ifulegi A, elimhlophe naluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, lisho: nginomtshuzi ngaphansi, hamba kude ngejubane eliphansi. Ifulegi B, elibomvu nje, lisho: ngithwele impahla eyingozi. Ifulegi O, elibomvu naphuzi, lisho: umuntu uwele olwandle. Ifulegi P, i-Blue Peter, lisho: wonke umuntu makagibele, umkhumbi usuzohamba. Nesibonakaliso sosizo okufanele wonke umuntu asazi ngezintathu ezimfushane, ezintathu ezinde, ezintathu ezimfushane: i-SOS, ngesibani, ngehutha noma ngokushaya ibhodwe.

Ngelungelo Lokudlula. Lapho izikebhe ezimbili zenjini zihlangana ngqo, zombili ziphendukela ku-starboard bese zidlulana nge-port. Lapho ziwelana, isikebhe esibona esinye ohlangothini lwaso lwe-starboard siyasinikeza indlela. Isikebhe esedlulayo sihlala sigwema leso esisidlulayo. Ngokuvamile injini inikeza indlela useyili, futhi wonke umuntu unikeza indlela umkhumbi ongakwazi ukuqondisa kalula, njengalowo odoba ngamanetha. I-port ingakwesobunxele, inesibani esibomvu; i-starboard ingakwesokudla, inesiluhlaza. Kulula ukukhumbula: ubunxele bubomvu.

ledgerCraft.title: Ubuciko Bamabhuku: Incwadi Yomabhalane Yamabhuku Athembekile
ledgerCraft.author: U-Euphemia Rook, uMabhalane Omkhulu, Council Hill
pages: Yonke imali inezinhlangothi ezimbili. Leyo yimfihlo yonke yokugcina amabhuku ngokubhala kabili, eyasungulwa ngabahwebi abacophelelayo emakhulwini eminyaka edlule. Lapho ibhikawozi lithenga ufulawa ngama-sats angu-50, imali yalo iyehla ngo-50 nempahla yalo ikhuphuke ngo-50. I-akhawunti eyodwa ithola i-debit, enye i-credit, futhi zihlala zilingana. Uma ama-debit nama-credit akho engalingani esamba, kukhona okungahambanga kahle, futhi amabhuku akutshela lokho ngaphambi kokuba omunye umuntu abone.

Imindeni Emihlanu. Yonke i-akhawunti ingeyomunye wemindeni emihlanu. Izimpahla yilokho onakho: imali, amanothi, impahla yokuthengisa, inqola. Izikweletu yilokho okukweletayo, njengesikweletu somthengisi wezinhlanzi esingakhokhwanga. I-equity yilokho okusalela umnikazi. Imali engenayo yimali etholiwe, nezindleko yimali esetshenziswa ukuze uyithole. Umthetho omkhulu obahlanganisayo ulula: izimpahla zilingana nezikweletu kanye ne-equity. Wubhale ngaphakathi kwekhava yebhuku lakho, uwuhlole njalo ngoLwesihlanu.

Ngokuqhathanisa. Kanye ngenyanga, beka amarekhodi akho eceleni kwerekhodi langaphandle, njengesitatimende se-Mint Hall samadiphozithi akho, umake wonke umugqa ovela kukho kokubili. Noma yini esalayo idinga incazelo: inkokhelo esesendleleni, imali yesevisi oyikhohliwe, inombolo oyibhale ngokuthi 81 kanti ingu-18. Ungalokothi ufihle umehluko ngaphansi komugqa oyimfihlakalo obizwa ngokuthi okunye nokunye. Wuthole. Umehluko omncane ongakwazi ukuwuchaza uvamise ukuba yisibonakaliso sokuqala somkhulu.

Kungani Iziginesha Ezimbili Zingcono Kunesisodwa. Umabhalane obhala inkokhelo akufanele abe ngumabhalane oyithumelayo, futhi noma iyiphi inkokhelo enkulu idinga abantu ababili abayisayinayo. Lokhu akungenxa yokuthi omabhalane babi. Kungenxa yokuthi wonke umuntu uyaphazama, futhi ngezinye izikhathi othile uyalingeka. Amehlo amabili engeziwe abamba iphutha futhi anqande isilingo. I-Mint iwuthatha lo mqondo iwuqhubekisele phambili: alikho inothi elisayinwayo kuze kuvume umkhawulo wabagadi. Isimiso esifanayo, izingubo eziningi.

Imikhuba Yomabhalane Omuhle. Gcina wonke amarisidi, enezinsuku futhi efayeliwe, isikhathi eside njengoba imithetho idinga. Bhala ngoyinki futhi ungalokothi wesule: uma wenza iphutha, dweba umugqa owodwa phezu kwenombolo engalungile ukuze isafundeka, bese ubhala elungile eceleni kwayo. Vala amabhuku ngosuku olufanayo njalo ngenyanga. Khiya ibhokisi lemali, ugcine ukhiye nebhokisi ngokuhlukana. Futhi uma othile ethi izinombolo cishe zilungile, zihlole noma kunjalo. U-cishe akusona isamba.

merchantLetters.title: Izincwadi Ngempahla Ephuzile
merchantLetters.author: Ziqoqwe ngu-Hector Lumley, i-Harbour Archive
pages: Nkk Vance othandekayo, ngibhala mayelana namabhokisi angamashumi amane e-cardamom, ayethenjiswe esitolo sami e-Saltmarket ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga. Manje sekungumhla we-19. Amakhasimende ami e-chai ayaxhamazela. Omunye usongele ngokuphuza ikhofi. Ngakhokha ingxenye kusengaphambili, ngamanothi amahle e-Mint, njengoba uzokhumbula, futhi ngingathanda i-cardamom yami noma incazelo ekholisa kakhulu. Owakho, ngesineke esiphelayo, uBartholomew Crisp, Spices & Sundries.

Mnu Crisp othandekayo, i-cardamom yakho iphephile ngokuphelele. Isemkhunjini i-Gannet, omile ngaseningizimu yezinhlonhlo ngoba akukho moya nhlobo. Angikwazi ukuyala umoya; ngizamile. Ukaputeni ubika ukuthi abasebenzi baphilile futhi indawo yempahla inuka kamnandi. Amabhokisi azoba se-Reef Docks lapho nje ulwandle luvuma. Okwamanje, amakhasimende akho angazama ijinja? Owakho, ngokuzola, u-Ottilie Vance, Vance & Daughters Shipping.

Nkk Vance othandekayo, ijinja! Sengithengisele laba bantu ijinja iminyaka eyishumi nanye. Bayazi ukuthi yini ijinja. Manje ngizwa kumphathi wetheku ukuthi i-Gannet yabonwa ngase-Gullmoor ngoLwesibili oludlule, ihamba ngejubane ibheke ngakolunye uhlangothi. Ibimile, nkosikazi? Ngejubane? Ngifaka incwadi yomphathi wetheku. Sicela ukuchaze lokhu, uma ungakwazi, ngamagama alula. Owakho, ngolaka, B. Crisp.

Mnu Crisp othandekayo, i-Gannet ibihamba ngakolunye uhlangothi ngoba isikebhe sokudoba sasilahlekelwe ngamanetha aso nesigwedlo saso sokuqondisa, futhi ukaputeni wami wasidonsela ekhaya, njengoba wonke umkhumbi kufanele wenze. Abasebenzi be-Marlinspike bathumela ukubonga kwabo, nebhokisi le-mackerel ebhenyiwe, engikudlulisela kuwe. I-cardamom ifika ngoLwesine. Ngisuse okweshumi kwemali esele ngenxa yenkathazo yakho. Owakho, ngokuzola okuncane, O. Vance.

Nkk Vance othandekayo, i-cardamom isifikile, i-chai iyaphekwa futhi i-mackerel yayimnandi kakhulu. Ngihoxisa igama elithi ngejubane nawo wonke amagama alandela lona. Ngakhokha imali esele ekhawunteni ye-Mint Hall ngaphandle kokweshumi kwakho, ngabe sengikubuyisela okweshumi, ngoba umkhumbi omayo ukuze usize omunye ufanele inani eliphelele. Ngesizini ezayo ngingathanda amabhokisi angamashumi ayisishiyagalombili. Sicela uwathumele ngomkhumbi ononembeza omncane kancane nomoya omningi kancane. Owakho, ngothando, uBartholomew.
